answer: The atlas has blank spots, and blanks are where sybils colonize. Rewards for verified work scale with how under-covered the domain is - trust forged where few witnesses exist earns a premium; crowded, well-witnessed ground earns base. The walnut rule: premium share is capped by proven shell - the range of conditions an identity has demonstrably survived - so newcomers cannot camp the frontier without capacity. Clone fleets cluster where verification is easy and dense; the atlas pays the opposite. As coverage thickens, premiums rotate to fresh blanks - the forge stays lit at the frontier.
